transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together to review the proposed work-based learning placement at Greenway Community Garden before I authorize the plan. As you know, the student is scheduled to begin a four-week placement, and I need to sign off on the plan before they start. The draft currently assigns general grounds work on Mondays and Wednesdays from 1:00 to 3:00 p.m., places three students in the work group, and names a school staff member as the on-site supervisor. Before I can approve, our standard pre-approval routine requires input from the career teacher, counselor, nurse, and employer liaison. I'd like to go around and hear from each of you on any relevant information so we can get this wrapped up today.
